line: Help now has a guide for your desk: your main jobs, step by step, each with a link to its screen.
The tour starts by itself only once on each device. Open it again any time from Help.
On a computer, the ? beside each screen's name opens help for that screen.
Help now lists recent changes under What's new, and this note shows them after each update.
Bed holds, ED counts, reports and archived history now stay consistent through access changes and interrupted saves.
Ward referrals show permitted progress while keeping other destinations private.
If another desk changes a record while your form is open, saving now tells you instead of overwriting it.
Moving someone from a locked bed to an open bed on the Bed board now asks for a reason, unless they are Voluntary.
Extending a legal form now needs the new expiry date as well as the time, both copied from the form.
Recording that someone has left on the Bed board now asks where they went. Nothing is chosen for you, and the confirmation shows your answer.
Pulling a bed now names the person it was pulled for.
The handover and phone ED now say "Form not recorded" instead of "No form" unless the person is Voluntary, and a patient's expected out day says "Not recorded" when no date is set.
The practice hospital feed in Tools now names each person with their record number and bed, and a confirmed message can be undone.
A handover page left open past midnight keeps the handover you chose, so it no longer says nothing has changed.
Each row of the ED board on a phone now shows the person's UMRN beside their name, so similar names are easier to tell apart.
Before a long weekend, the forecast's weekend or holiday figure now runs to the first working day after it, not just the third day.
